name: Lava Salamander
lore: Basks in cooling magma and bites with a mouthful of flame. Its hide stays warm for hours after it falls.

attack.source_name: Fire bite attack. Attacks by biting with flames.

die.source_name: Fades unconscious into the ground and dissapers

walk.source_name: Walk with all 4 legs in an animation that is easy to loop
